final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT income.link_to_member) AS member_count FROM income JOIN member ON member.member_id = income.link_to_member JOIN major ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major GROUP BY major.department), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.department, step1.member_count, CAST(step1.member_count AS REAL) / step2.total_count AS share FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM step3) SELECT SUM(step3.member_count), AVG(step3.share), AVG(step3.share - step4.average_share) FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step4.average_share IS NOT NULL AND step3.share > step4.average_share
